text:
mike: Quick sync - HW partner asked for a compact Datadog + OTLP marketplace tile that shows MIG partitions, per-partition inference latency, and trace correlation. Can we scope a minimal deliverable for the marketplace listing?
anya: I can take the UX for the tile. Minimal panels: per-MIG latency heatmap, memory headroom gauge, recent traces linked to partition tag.
suresh: Tech notes: need to ensure the OTLP collector attaches resource.attributes.device.partition_id and device.memory.total bytes. Datadog should map partition_id -> tag 'mig_partition'.
viv: Also surface model.selector and model.version as tags so customers can filter by model on the tile.
mike: Good point. Let's pick a tiny attribute set for GA: device.id, device.partition_id, device.memory.used_mb, inference.latency_ms, model.name, model.version, trace_id.
anya: For the dashboard mock I only need example series. Can someone paste a short OTLP metric + trace sample?
suresh: Pseudo payloads below (keeps it tiny):
```json
{"resource":{"attributes":{"device.id":"node-1","device.partition_id":"mig0","model.name":"rw-qa","model.version":"v2"}},"metrics":[{"name":"inference.latency_ms","value":12.4}],"traces":[{"span":{"name":"inference.exec","trace_id":"abc123","attributes":{"device.partition_id":"mig0","model.name":"rw-qa"}}}]}
```
viv: Datadog mapping rules: map inference.latency_ms -> gauge 'redwood.inference.latency_ms', device.partition_id -> tag 'mig_partition', model.name -> tag 'model'. I'll draft a JSON mapping.
anya: For marketplace we should provide a lightweight install snippet for OTLP collector that works in cloud and private deployments. Keep auth examples generic.
marketing-bot: Reminder: partner approvals for co-marketing + logo usage take 10 business days. Need draft tile copy and partner logo assets before we schedule public announcement.
ops-bot: Checklist updated: [x] attr list, [ ] marketplace tile mock, [ ] mapping JSON, [ ] collector snippet, [ ] co-marketing draft.
mike: Operational note: retention defaults for marketplace tile should be 7d for metrics, 30d for traces (sampled). We need a short-cost example for partners (per 1k qps baseline).
suresh: Back-of-envelope for 1k qps baseline: 1 metric per inference -> ~60M metrics/hour; traces sampled 2% of requests -> ~1.2M spans/hour (assume 3 spans per sampled request). We'll add spreadsheet later.
anya: I'll produce the tile mock with those retention settings and example widgets. Target mock by Tue EOD.
viv: I'll prepare the Datadog mapping PR and include example queries:
```
avg:redwood.inference.latency_ms{mig_partition:mig0,model:rw-qa}.rollup(max, 60)
```
suresh: For air-gapped SI installs, include a doc that maps collector -> internal datadog proxy and example curl for pushing OTLP. I'll sketch that.
mike: Action items: anya -> tile mock (Tue), viv -> mapping PR (Wed), suresh -> collector snippets + SI doc (Wed), marketing-bot -> start co-marketing template (Fri).
marketing-bot: Scheduled internal review in 8 business days.
ops-bot: Reminder: please update checklist when PRs are opened. :thumbsup:
